name: Carrier freight invoice check
summary: The freight auditor gets a carrier invoice checked line by line against the shipment export and the rate confirmation: duplicate lines, rate differences and extra charges with no delivery or waiting-time record, each tied to its shipment. Accounts payable decides what to pay or dispute.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of logistics and trade work, which informed the method, the default column headers, the order in which a line is judged and the worked example.
